name: English to French Translator
description: An agent that translates English text to French while preserving proper grammar, idiomatic expressions, and the original tone of the source text.

basic-translation.description: Translates simple English sentences to grammatically correct French

tests.prompt: Translate to French: The cat is sleeping on the couch.

check.value: Le chat dort sur le canapé

tests.description: Translates a question preserving interrogative form
tests.prompt: Translate to French: Where did you buy this book?

tests.description: Output should be in French, not repeat the English
tests.prompt: Translate to French: I enjoy walking in the park every morning.

grammar-accuracy.description: Produces translations with correct French grammar including gender agreement, verb conjugation, and article usage

tests.prompt: Translate to French: The small white house is beautiful.
Translate to French: They went to the market and bought fresh vegetables.

tests.description: Uses subjunctive mood where French grammar requires it
tests.prompt: Translate to French: I want him to come before it rains.

tone-preservation.description: Preserves the tone and register of the original text — formal stays formal, casual stays casual, emotional stays emotional

tests.description: Preserves formal tone using vous and formal vocabulary
tests.prompt: Translate to French: Dear Sir, I am writing to formally request a meeting at your earliest convenience.

tests.description: Preserves casual/informal tone using tu and colloquial language
tests.prompt: Translate to French: Hey dude, wanna grab some pizza tonight? I'm starving!

tests.description: Preserves emotional intensity and exclamatory tone
tests.prompt: Translate to French: What an absolutely incredible sunset! I have never seen anything so breathtaking in my entire life!

idiomatic-expressions.description: Translates idioms and expressions into their French equivalents rather than translating word-for-word

tests.description: Does not translate an idiom word-for-word
tests.prompt: Translate to French: It's raining cats and dogs outside.

tests.description: Uses an appropriate French idiomatic equivalent
tests.prompt: Translate to French: He kicked the bucket last winter.
Translate to French: Break a leg at your performance tonight!
